description:
Your peptide routine, organized.

Protocola helps you keep a clear record of the protocols you already follow. Log doses, manage vials, and review your history in one focused iPhone app.

TRACK YOUR ROUTINE

• See what's scheduled today and record a dose in a few taps.
• Keep your protocol details and planned phases in one place.
• Review your dose history and see when your protocol changed.

STAY AHEAD OF YOUR VIALS

• Record your vials and keep track of available supply.
• See estimated depletion based on your recorded schedule.
• View in-app warnings for approaching depletion or vial expiry.

SEE THE BIGGER PICTURE

• Explore your recorded activity and trends over time.
• Find past entries without sorting through notes or spreadsheets.
• Keep a consistent timeline of what you've tracked.

DESIGNED FOR PRIVACY

Protocola is local-first. Your tracking records are stored on your iPhone by default, so you can get started without creating an account.

Start with the essentials free, with one active protocol. Protocola Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription ($3.99 per week or $9.99 per month, charged to your Apple ID through your App Store account) that unlocks unlimited active protocols, Ask Protocola, advanced comparisons, and Visit Summaries. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store settings.

IMPORTANT

Protocola is a personal record-keeping tool, not medical advice. It does not prescribe treatments or recommend substances or doses. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.
promotionalText: Keep your peptide records in one place. Log doses, follow your schedule, monitor vial inventory, and understand your history without the clutter.
